"""Standalone behavioral verification of ticket #30289 fix (view-only M2M inlines).

Uses the django test suite's own settings + the admin_inlines test app.
"""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-11149-nopanel')
sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-11149-nopanel/tests')

os.environ['DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE'] = 'test_sqlite'

import django
django.setup()

from django.contrib.auth.models import Permission, User
from django.test import Client
from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment, get_runner
from django.conf import settings
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner

setup_test_environment()
runner = DiscoverRunner(verbosity=0, interactive=False)
old_config = runner.setup_databases()

from django.urls import reverse
from admin_inlines.models import Author, Book
from admin_inlines.admin import site as admin_inlines_site  # noqa

# Create superuser-free view-only user
User.objects.create_superuser('super', 'super@example.com', 'secret')
user = User.objects.create_user('viewonly', 'v@example.com', 'secret')
book_ct = None
from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
book_ct = ContentType.objects.get_for_model(Book)
view_perm = Permission.objects.get(codename='view_book', content_type=book_ct)
user.user_permissions.add(view_perm)

# viewuser also needs view/change on Author (parent model) to access the change page
from django.contrib.auth import get_permission_codename
author_ct = ContentType.objects.get_for_model(Author)
user.user_permissions.add(Permission.objects.get(
    codename=get_permission_codename('view', author_ct._meta if hasattr(author_ct, '_meta') else author_ct), content_type=author_ct))

client = Client()
client.force_login(user)

author = Author.objects.create(pk=1, name='The Author')
book = author.books.create(name='The inline Book')
through = Author.books.through.objects.get(author=author, book=book)

change_url = reverse('admin:admin_inlines_author_change', args=(author.pk,))

# 1. GET the change page as view-only user
resp = client.get(change_url)
assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.status_code
body = resp.content.decode()

# Inline must be visible (view permission) ...
assert 'Author-book relationships' in body, 'inline not rendered'
# ... but NOT editable: no "Add another" link
assert 'Add another Author-Book Relationship' not in body, 'BUG: add link shown to view-only user'
# ... and no DELETE checkbox
assert 'id_Author_books-0-DELETE' not in body, 'BUG: delete checkbox shown to view-only user'

# 2. POST an add of a new through row as view-only user -> must be ignored
data = {
    'name': 'The Author',
    'Author_books-TOTAL_FORMS': '4',
    'Author_books-INITIAL_FORMS': '1',
    'Author_books-0-id': str(through.pk),
    'Author_books-0-book': str(book.pk),
    'Author_books-1-id': '',
    'Author_books-1-book': '',
    'Author_books-2-id': '',
    'Author_books-2-book': '',
    'Author_books-3-id': '',
    'Author_books-3-book': '',
}
resp = client.post(change_url, data)
assert resp.status_code == 302, resp.status_code
assert Author.books.through.objects.count() == 1, \
    'BUG: view-only user could ADD an inline row (%d rows)' % Author.books.through.objects.count()

# 3. POST a delete of the existing through row as view-only user -> must be ignored
data = {
    'name': 'The Author',
    'Author_books-TOTAL_FORMS': '1',
    'Author_books-INITIAL_FORMS': '1',
    'Author_books-0-id': str(through.pk),
    'Author_books-0-book': str(book.pk),
    'Author_books-0-DELETE': 'on',
}
resp = client.post(change_url, data)
assert resp.status_code == 302, resp.status_code
assert Author.books.through.objects.count() == 1, \
    'BUG: view-only user could DELETE an inline row (%d rows)' % Author.books.through.objects.count()

# 4. Sanity: a user WITH change perm on Book can still add/delete
user.user_permissions.add(Permission.objects.get(codename='change_book', content_type=book_ct))
# re-login to refresh permission cache
client2 = Client()
from django.contrib.auth.models import User as U
client2.force_login(U.objects.get(username='viewonly'))
data = {
    'name': 'The Author',
    'Author_books-TOTAL_FORMS': '2',
    'Author_books-INITIAL_FORMS': '1',
    'Author_books-0-id': str(through.pk),
    'Author_books-0-book': str(book.pk),
    'Author_books-1-id': '',
    'Author_books-1-book': str(book.pk),
}
resp = client2.post(change_url, data)
assert resp.status_code == 302, resp.status_code
assert Author.books.through.objects.count() == 2, \
    'REGRESSION: user with change perm could NOT add inline row (%d rows)' % Author.books.through.objects.count()

print('ALL BEHAVIOR CHECKS PASSED: view-only user cannot add/delete M2M inline rows; change-perm user can.')

runner.teardown_databases(old_config)

"""TEMPORARY behavioral verification for ticket #30289 (deleted after run).

Mirrors the assertions of the upstream fix's tests: a user with only the
view permission must be able to SEE the m2m inline but not add/change/delete.
"""
from django.contrib.auth.models import Permission
from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
from django.template.response import TemplateResponse
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse

from .models import Author, Book


class TmpViewOnlyInlineTests(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.user = User = None  # placeholder to avoid confusion
        from django.contrib.auth.models import User as U
        cls.user = U(username='viewonly', is_staff=True, is_active=True)
        cls.user.set_password('secret')
        cls.user.save()

        cls.author_ct = ContentType.objects.get_for_model(Author)
        cls.book_ct = ContentType.objects.get_for_model(Book)
        # view permission on the inline's target model (Book) only
        permission = Permission.objects.get(codename='view_book', content_type=cls.book_ct)
        cls.user.user_permissions.add(permission)

        author = Author.objects.create(pk=1, name='The Author')
        cls.book = author.books.create(name='The inline Book')
        cls.author_change_url = reverse('admin:admin_inlines_author_change', args=(author.id,))
        through = Author.books.through.objects.get(author=author, book=cls.book)
        cls.through_id = through.pk

    def setUp(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.user)

    def test_change_view_view_only_inline_not_editable(self):
        response = self.client.get(self.author_change_url)
        self.assertIsInstance(response, TemplateResponse)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        formset = response.context['inline_admin_formsets'][0]
        self.assertIs(formset.has_view_permission, True)
        self.assertIs(formset.has_add_permission, False)
        self.assertIs(formset.has_change_permission, False)
        self.assertIs(formset.has_delete_permission, False)
        # Inline is rendered read-only: no add link, no delete checkbox
        self.assertNotContains(response, 'Add another Author-Book Relationship')
        self.assertNotContains(
            response,
            '<input type="checkbox" name="Author_books-0-DELETE" id="id_Author_books-0-DELETE">',
            html=True,
        )

    def test_post_cannot_add_inline_row(self):
        count = Author.books.through.objects.count()
        data = {
            'name': 'The Author',
            'Author_books-TOTAL_FORMS': '4',
            'Author_books-INITIAL_FORMS': '1',
            'Author_books-0-id': str(self.through_id),
            'Author_books-0-book': str(self.book.pk),
            'Author_books-1-id': '',
            'Author_books-1-book': str(self.book.pk),
        }
        response = self.client.post(self.author_change_url, data)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(Author.books.through.objects.count(), count)

    def test_post_cannot_delete_inline_row(self):
        count = Author.books.through.objects.count()
        data = {
            'name': 'The Author',
            'Author_books-TOTAL_FORMS': '1',
            'Author_books-INITIAL_FORMS': '1',
            'Author_books-0-id': str(self.through_id),
            'Author_books-0-book': str(self.book.pk),
            'Author_books-0-DELETE': 'on',
        }
        response = self.client.post(self.author_change_url, data)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(Author.books.through.objects.count(), count)

    def test_change_perm_user_can_still_add(self):
        from django.contrib.auth.models import User as U
        self.user.user_permissions.add(
            Permission.objects.get(codename='change_book', content_type=self.book_ct))
        # force re-auth to refresh the permission cache
        self.client.force_login(U.objects.get(username='viewonly'))
        count = Author.books.through.objects.count()
        data = {
            'name': 'The Author',
            'Author_books-TOTAL_FORMS': '2',
            'Author_books-INITIAL_FORMS': '1',
            'Author_books-0-id': str(self.through_id),
            'Author_books-0-book': str(self.book.pk),
            'Author_books-1-id': '',
            'Author_books-1-book': str(self.book.pk),
        }
        response = self.client.post(self.author_change_url, data)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(Author.books.through.objects.count(), count + 1)
